title: Ashram Online (indie MMORPG, solo dev): ~900 players through the beta, the netcode just got rebuilt, and a big update is coming
author: Fun_Bumblebee_3978
selftext:
I'm the solo developer of Ashram Online, a free tab-target MMORPG on Steam (playtest phase). A short update on where the beta stands:

• 900 players have already entered the world since the playtest opened, close to 870 of them active this week.

• The netcode was rebuilt over the last two weeks: a 20 Hz authoritative server, movement trust with a server-side guard against speed hacks, Iris replication with distance-based interest (you see the 40 closest players within 90 m), and three channels of 100 players each that open and close on demand.

• Night is back with a full day cycle, crafting tables got Create / Refine / Reforge, and there are four lineages with their own skill trees.

What's coming next: a bigger inventory from level 1, bosses that show their respawn timer right in the quest log, summons with real creature models, and a long list of fixes reported by you on the in-game bug button (thank you, seriously).

It's free, it's on Steam, and every report gets read: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5188230/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5188230/)

Discord: [https://discord.gg/QN75Zd8Yk5](https://discord.gg/QN75Zd8Yk5)

Happy to answer anything about the netcode or the design in the comments.
